attributes.check1: Intelligence or Ranged or Arcane or Craft 13
attributes.name: Shock Bullets
attributes.powers:
Display this card; you may not do so during an encounter. After playing this card, if you have more than 2 cards that have the Ammunition trait displayed, recharge 1 of them.

While displayed, when you play a card that has the Firearm trait on your combat check, you may add the Electricity and Magic traits. If you do so against a non-villain monster that has an effect that happens after you act, you may additionally discard this card to ignore that effect. You may succeed at a Craft 13 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
